summary: Completed testing of Khurpi Microgreens app new features. Backend: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working. Fixed coupon validation endpoint method mismatch (GET→POST).
critical_code_review_comments: Admin order status update working correctly with JSON body {status: 'preparing'}
Coupon validation endpoint uses POST method - frontend was fixed to match
Free delivery threshold fetched from admin settings correctly
Order detail page shows all order info including items, address, payment
Addresses page shows delivery fee for each address
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/Checkout.js - Fixed coupon validation to use POST instead of GET
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: Admin order status update, Checkout coupon input, Free delivery threshold, T&C links, Microgreens benefits section, Order detail page, Address delivery fee display. Fixed coupon validation method from GET to POST in Checkout.js.

ADMIN_ORDER_STATUS_UPDATE.details: Admin can expand order and click status buttons (Confirmed, Preparing, Out For Delivery, Delivered, Cancelled). Status updates via PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status with JSON body.

CHECKOUT_COUPON_INPUT.details: Checkout page has 'Have a Coupon?' section with input field and Apply button. Fixed frontend to use POST method for coupon validation.

FREE_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD.details: Free delivery displayed when subtotal >= ₹1000 threshold. Threshold fetched from admin settings via /api/admin/settings/all.

TERMS_CONDITIONS_LINK.details: T&C link visible on Login page and Checkout page. Links to /terms page.

MICROGREENS_BENEFITS_SECTION.details: Landing page has 'Why Microgreens?' section with 6 benefits: 40x More Nutrients, Boosts Immunity, Heart Health, Brain Function, Natural Energy, Glowing Skin.

ORDER_DETAIL_PAGE.details: Clicking order card on My Orders page navigates to /order/{id}. Shows Order Status, Order Items with images, Delivery Address, Payment Summary with Payment ID.

ADDRESS_DELIVERY_FEE_DISPLAY.details: Addresses page shows delivery fee for each address. 'Free Delivery' in green for nearby addresses, 'Delivery: ₹120' in amber for farther addresses.

mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs - all operations use real backend endpoints
